main_body: A palm tree: a slightly curved segmented brown trunk and a drooping green frond crown with two orange coconuts at the top of the trunk.
top_band: none. The column through the trunk reads as green fronds (rows ~2-10), then orange coconuts and brown trunk. There is no horizontal top surface, only the organic crown silhouette.
evidence: This is an organic plant, a palm seen from the side with a drooping crown. It has no top plane and front face construction. The crown is a tangle of fronds and the trunk is a vertical cylinder. There is no flat horizontal surface, so the 3/4 contract (top band + front face) is not met. Being strict, it is a side-view silhouette without a visible top surface.

style.evidence: The palm has about 4 greens in the fronds (dark, mid, light, highlight) and about 4 browns with segment banding on the trunk. Outlines are dark green and dark brown, tinted to the material and used selectively. The texture is modest: trunk rings and frond clumps are present, but the fronds are sparse and thin with small areas of single-tone fill, and the crown has less clumped leaf detail than the full, dense Beodeul canopies. Per-tile density is a bit lower than the reference, which is round and has 5-6 steps with leaf clumps.
